question: Does the retained native-tissue comparison teach enough new useful EMC knowledge for a concise comparative-phenotype report under the actual CSPG4 RNA evidence standard, after precise access/omission and culture-context follow-through?
fixed_claim: Lower GPNMB bulk RNA abundance in the evaluated source-labelled EMC specimens relative to LGFMS on the two retained source assay scales, with valid high EMC exceptions. Distinct assays provide corroboration, not certified independent patient replication.
practical_consequence: A disease-specific high-RNA LGFMS comparison together with ordinary and high-RNA EMC specimens, with malignant/myeloid/stromal localization compartments considered; no universal low phenotype or diagnostic/therapeutic recommendation.
standard: Independent validity, value and omission review; all identifiable relevant public EMC conditions evaluated/reused or source-linked explicit pending/unsuitable/unavailable status. Do not require protein, a fresh cohort, every model positive, or absolute literature-absence proof for a descriptive RNA finding. Any genuine suitable accessible interpretation-changing input must be executed or scientifically dispositioned before promotion.
defeats: Equivalent useful comparative finding already established in an actual primary source removes standalone contribution.
Invalid specimen/gene/capture measurements or an evaluated additional relevant matched observation defeats the stated stable relative comparison.
An accessible suitable material measurement left unevaluated prevents promotion until follow-through.
Contribution reduces to inventory, arithmetic, our unpublished repair, or an invented target-enrichment rebuttal rather than useful observed EMC knowledge.
non_defeats_by_themselves: Unknown donor overlap, handling/mixture confounding or missing protein constrain the observational claim and do not alone erase it.
Valid high EMC exceptions and MLPS nonreplication must stay explicit, defeating uniform-low/pan-myxoid claims rather than being removed.
Unresolved/authentication-limited or unavailable source evidence stays explicit; it is neither negative biology nor proof of complete discovery.
